content: Kuku mayika jirraynka weddingba.
Jesusangka jananin binal-bungan baja storybu. Nyulu jananin kari junkaynjaku binal-bungan, yamba nyulu story balkan, binal-bunganka.
Nyulu yalaman, “Godungku nyungu bama ngulkurrduku kujil. Yinya yala yanyu story. Nyubun maja jirray, king. Nyulu mayi jirray-bunganka, kangkal nyungu marrymanka.
Nyulu majangka nyungu workingman yungan bama kunjanka mayika yalbaynka. Yamba jana kari kadarin, wawu kari.

Nyulu workingman yindu-yindu yungan. Nyulu jananda yalaman, ‘Yurra bamanda yalamaka, “Ngayu mayi yalbay ready-bungan. Wubul minya bulki wandul kuninda, minya, mayi ready-bunganda, nukanka. Yurra wubulku jinbalku kadarikada.” ’
Yamba jana bamangka jananin workingmen bayjan, kari mayinga weddingmunbu kadarin. Nyubun bama nyunguwunbu stationba dungan, yindu nyunguwunbu shopmunbu dungan.
Kanbalda bamangka jananin workingmen karrban, jukubu kunin, yarkinkaku kunin.
Yinyaynka nyulu maja king kuli-kadan. Nyulu soldier-soldier yungan, jananin bama yarkinkaku kuninka, jananga town wayjunku.
Yinyamun nyulu majangka nyunguwunbu workingmenanda yalaman, ‘Ngayu weddingmunku ready-bunganda, jana yinyarrin bama ngayu kunjan, jana ngulkurr kari, buyun.
Yurra baral-baraldarr dungayda, bama wubulku kunja. Yurra bama nyajil, kunjada, mayinga kadanka.’
Jana workingmen dunganda, bama wubul muru-bungan weddingmunku, kanbal ngulkurr, kanbal buyun. Yinya bayanba bama wubul, kanbinkuda.

“Juma nyulu maja king kananga kadan, bama nyajinka. Nyulu nyubun dingkar nyajin, nyulu dingkarangka kambi ngulkurr kari didan. Jana yinyaymba yalaku, jana bama weddingmunku kunjal, kambi ngulkurr dajil bamanga wubulbuku, didanka. Bama wubulku kambiji ngulkurrji kadayda weddingmunbu.
Majangka dingkaranda yalaman, ‘Jawun, yundu wanjarrku kananga kadan, kambi ngulkurr kari?’ Yamba nyulu dingkarangka nyungun kuku kari manin.
Yinyamun nyulu majangka nyunguwunbu workingmenanda yalaman, ‘Nyungun mara, and jina karrabu kaja. Ngalkalba nguwul-nguwulbu yilba. Yinyaymba nyulu badi, warrngkaykuda, dirra majajikuda.’”
Jesusangka yalamanda, “Yinya story yala yanyu: Godungku bama wubulku kunjal, yamba kanbal kari milka-janay, nyungu bamamanka. Kulurku milka-janay.”
Kuku moneyka taxmunku.
Wawu yinyamun jana Pharisee-warra jana-karrajiku balkawan, yanday-bunganka Jesus kukubu walu ngangkal-ngangkal-bunganka, catchim-bunganka.

Jana dingkar-dingkar wangkanin, kanbal jananga, kanbal Herodamu, jananin yungan Jesusanda. Jana Jesusanda yalaman, “Maja, nganjin binal yundu kuku manubajaku balkal. Nganjin binal yundu bama manubajabuku binal-bungal Godundumunku baralka. Nganjin binal yundu yinyil kari bamanka majanka, yundu still junkayku balkal. Kanbal yununku wawu kari, yamba yundu jananin bayjal. Yundu kuku kari jurrkil bamanka.
Yala, wanjarrmal taxmunku? Yinya yalada ngana money tax payim-bunganka majanda jirrayanda townbu Rome? Nganandamundu lawmundu kiril or kari?”
Yamba Jesus binal jana nyungun walu ngangkal-ngangkal-bunganka, catchim-bunganka. Nyulu jananda yalaman, “Yurra bulu-duray, nganya jurril-bunganka. Yurra nganya mambarrinka kuku buyun balkanka.
Kulji money ngaykundu milbi, tax payim-bunganka.” Jana kulji money dajin nyungundu.
Nyulu jananda babajin, “Walu ngurma wanjuyimbu kuljinga? Burri wanju moneynga?”

Jana yalaman, “Maja yalbay townbu Rome.” Jesusangka jananda yalamanda, “Yalada, yurra majanda yalbaymba money nyungunduku daya. Yamba Godunduku daya yinya Godumuku, money, work. Nyungundu yurraku yalarrku dajijika.”
Jana Jesusamu kuku nyajin, kungkurr-kadarinda, nyulu binal bajaku. Yinyamun jana nyungun bawan, dungarinda.
Kuku juranmanka baja yarkinmun.
Yala-yalaku kanbal Sadducee-warra Jesusanda kadarin. Jana balu nyajil bama kari juranmal baja yarkinmun.
Jana Jesusanda yalaman, “Maja, Mosesangka ngadiku balkan,

content.text: ‘Kaki dingkar kangkal-kariku wulay, nyunguwundu yabajungku yinya jalbu bunjil wunay. Bulanga kangkal-kangkal yala yabanga kangkal-kangkal.’

content: Yala, yundu yanyu story nyaka. Ngadiku yaba-yabaju 7-bala yalaymba bundandan. Nyulu yaba jakalbamunku marrymanijin, yamba nyulu kangkal-kariku wulan, manyarr bawan yabajundu.

Yabajungku jurungu bunjil manyarr wunan. Nyulu yalarrku kangkal-kariku wulaynda. Yabajungku jurungu bunjil manyarr wunanda. Nyulu kangkal-kariku wulanda. Kanbal-kanbalda yalarrku jalbu bunjil wunan yabandamun, kangkal-kariku wulan.
Yinyamun jalbuda wulan.
Kaki jumalu wubulku bama juranmal baja, manyarr wanyambaku? Jananga yaba-yabajumuku wubulbuku manyarr.”
Jesusangka jananda yalaman, “Yurra wadu-wadumankuda. Yurra binal kari Godundumunku kukuku, nyunguwunku junkurrku.
Bama juranmal baja yarkinmun, jana kari marrymal baja. Jana yala jiri-warra, jana kari marrymal baja.
Yamba yurra balkal-balkawan yarkinanka, nyulu kari juranmal baja. Yurra nguba Godumu kaban kariku nyajin.
Godungku yalaman,

content.text: ‘Ngayu Abrahamamu God, ngayu Isaacamu God, ngayu Jacobamu God.’

content: Jana ngadiku wularin, yamba nyulu God janangaku God, jana juranku bundandanya nyungunji. Nyulu God yarkin-warramu kari. Nyulu God juran-warramuku, jana yarkinmun juranmal baja.”
Jana bamangka wubulduku yinya kuku nyajin, jana kungkurr-kadarin nyunguwunku kukuku.
Yanyu kuku jirray bajaku.
Jana Pharisee-warrangka kuku nyajin Jesusangka Sadducee-warra kuku-kari-bunganya, jana wubulku murumarinda.
Nyubun janandamun, nyulu teacher lawmunku. Nyulu Jesus babanka kukubu, catchim-bunganka.
Nyulu Jesusanda babajin, “Maja, wanjinyaku kuku yalbayku Godungku balkan?”
Jesusangka balkan,

content.text: “‘Yundu wawu jirraymaka yunuwunku Godunku. Nyungun wawungu, and dukurrbu kuji, junkaynjaku junkurr-murubuku wukurrika. Milkanga Godunjiku bunday.’

content: Yinya kuku yalbayku Godungku balkan.
Yanyu jarra buban kuku;

content.text: ‘Yundu wawu jirraymaka bamanka yindu-yinduynku. Jananka wawu jirraymaka yala yununkuku, yala yundu yunuwunku jawun-karranka wawu.’

content: Jana, Mosesangka, prophet-prophetangka, jana wubulduku bama binal-bungan yinyaynka kukuku.”
Kuku bamanka Godundumun, Christanka.
Jana Pharisee-warra murumarin Jesusanda. Jesusangka jananda babajin,
“Yala nyungunku Christanka? Nyulu bamandamun wanjundumun?” Jana yalaman, “Nyulu Christ Davidandamun.”
Jesusangka jananda yalaman, “Godundumundu Wawubu dayirrda Davidanda balkan Christ maja bambanka. Nyulu Davidangka Godundumunbu kabanba balkan,

content.text: ‘Nyulu Majangka Godungku yalaman ngaykuwundu majanda, “Ngali majaku bunday, muruku. Kanbal yununku wawu kari bajaku, ngayu jananin buyun-damal. Yundu maja jirraymal jananka.” ’

content: Davidangka Christ maja bamban, nyulu Christ wanjarrku Davidandamun kadan?”
Jana Pharisee-warrangka nyungundu kuku kari manin baja, jana binal kari. Yinyamun jana bama wubulku yinyilmarin Jesusanda kuku babajinka baja, catchim-bunganka.
